'''August 1999 Johnson City tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Johnson City, TN on 13 August 1999. It is known from Kevin Mulligan's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d19">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-24-johnson-city-tn-8-13-99d19/ johnson-city-tn-8-13-99], DeckTech (Kevin "KitNorja" Mulligan, 24 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-24-johnson-city-tn-8-13-99d19/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 August 1999
* '''Site:''' Johnson City, TN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
